what: Runner-contract baseline on the accepted ab-wildfire-ia-escape artifact, fetched from private staging rather than rebuilt: re-accept the five fetched files against the gate's own collected report BEFORE any score, materialize the runner workdir (public train+eval only; the private holdout is fetched for --accept over the full artifact but never copied into a workdir), run the benchmark's own train.py and validate.sh unmodified, then compute the PRE-REGISTERED deciding check: the runner model's per-row eval scores (same code path as validate.py) vs every triad member (persistence analogue = assessment_hectares, calendar/identity prior from train, plus the degenerate majority constant) on identical eval rows, day-clustered paired bootstrap, cluster = assessment_date. The construction-time full-feature logistic reference is recorded as a supplementary model-vs-model comparison, not a deciding member. Headroom is demonstrated ONLY if the model beats EVERY member with a CI excluding zero in its favour (and, for the degenerate constant member, its own day-cluster-bootstrap AUC CI lies entirely above 0.5); triad dominance -> recorded defect, drop or re-target. Contract only, no agent loop, no holdout score.
